name: Jonathan Carevin
summary: In Darkshire, Jonathan Carevin hunts the dangers gathering in Duskwood. He and his family take the fight beyond the Night Watch's patrols, pursuing undead, worgen, demons, and heretics beneath the forest canopy.

sections.title: The Carevin Crusade
sections.body: The Night Watch guards Darkshire and patrols its roads, but Jonathan Carevin believes defense alone cannot protect the township. He hunts the unholy creatures roaming Duskwood with his family and allies such as Calor. His crusade, fought in the name of the Light, targets demons, undead, and heretics across the region.

sections.title: The Shadow of the Worgen
sections.body: Jonathan Carevin watches the forest's savage, wolf-like worgen as closely as its skeletons and ghouls. Their presence threatens a settlement already under siege. He coordinates investigations to learn where the worgen came from and to stop their nightly prowling.

faq.answer: Jonathan Carevin hunts monsters in Duskwood from his home in Darkshire. He leads his family in a direct fight against the creatures haunting the forest.

faq.q: How does he differ from the Night Watch?
faq.answer: The Night Watch guards Darkshire and keeps watch on its roads. Jonathan and his allies pursue undead and other abominations through Duskwood, seeking to destroy them at their source.
Jonathan hunts undead, worgen, demons, and anyone who shelters or aids these creatures.

faq.q: Is Jonathan affiliated with the Scarlet Crusade?
faq.answer: Jonathan's fierce words, devotion to the Light, and intolerance of corruption echo Scarlet beliefs. He operates independently with his family in Darkshire.

faq.q: Who assists Jonathan in his mission?
faq.answer: Jonathan's family and allies such as Calor help him hunt the monsters moving through the woods.

faq.q: What is his connection to the worgen?
faq.answer: Jonathan sees the worgen as an unnatural threat to Duskwood's people. He asks travelers to investigate where they came from in the wilderness.

angles.text: If you fight for the Alliance to steady Duskwood, Jonathan Carevin strikes at supernatural threats Stormwind has left unchecked.
As a paladin, you may recognize Carevin's zeal and his call on the Light against demonic and undead corruption.
As a hunter, you share Carevin's practice of tracking and hunting Duskwood's night predators.
